_comment: WC2026 ROUND OF 16 (bracket tie 95: winner of Argentina-Cape Verde vs winner of Australia-Egypt). KNOCKOUT: no draw -- level after 90' -> extra time -> penalties, so the deliverable is who ADVANCES. Winner goes to QF100 to meet the Switzerland-Colombia winner (tie 96) in the quarter-finals. Routes: Argentina WON Group J with a PERFECT nine (3-0 Algeria, 2-0 Austria, 3-1 Jordan; 9 pts, GF 8 GA 1, rating 95) -- tournament top-tier -- then survived a scare, beating Cape Verde 3-2 in EXTRA TIME (1-1 at 90') in the R16... no, in the R32; the proven block took them deep. Egypt came through Group G (1-1 Belgium, 3-1 New Zealand, 1-1 Iran; 5 pts, GF 5 GA 3, rating 74) -- organized, HELD Belgium 1-1 -- then ELIMINATED Australia on penalties (1-1) in the R32; a disciplined, tournament-tough grinder with a modest attack (GF 5, 3 vs NZ). Class gap is ENORMOUS (~21, 95 vs 74) -> Argentina a heavy favourite; the 'elite favourite vs organized defensive underdog' archetype (like Argentina-Cape Verde, but Egypt is a bit stronger and more of a genuine side than a pure minnow block). FULL FRAMEWORK APPLIED: (1) DON'T FADE THE ELITE -- first pass sat 3.5 pts below the market on Argentina (71.1 vs 74.6); lifted ARG 2.20 -> 2.35 to align (74.1 vs 74.6, div 0.5). (2) BTTS RULE -- Egypt has a MODEST attack (not an elite striker) -> trimmed Egypt's lambda (0.68) -> BTTS-No 54.7%, Argentina clean sheet 50.7%. (3) ARGENTINA-CAPE VERDE REFINEMENT -- Egypt is a PROVEN grinder (held Belgium 1-1, beat Australia on penalties), so keep the draw/ET tail HONEST (ET 17.5%, pens 7.7%) and do NOT zero their attack (Egypt lambda 0.68 keeps BTTS 45%, not ~0). Argentina should WIN, likely a controlled-to-comfortable margin (1-0/2-0/3-0), Egypt rarely scores; but Egypt's grind + penalty pedigree gives a modest, real deep/ET tail (Cape Verde already took Argentina to ET once). Home = Argentina (nominal; neutral venue). Cards not modelled (referee TBD).

_postmatch.result: Argentina 3-2 Egypt. Argentina advance to the quarter-finals (where they meet the Switzerland-Colombia winner), but only after a STUNNING comeback: Egypt led 2-0 until the 80th minute, and Argentina scored THREE late goals to win 3-2. Settled in 90'.

_postmatch.verdict: Right on the DELIVERABLE, badly wrong on the TEXTURE -- and it is the SECOND straight time Argentina has been taken to the brink by an organized underdog. Argentina advanced as the 86.1% pick (✅), but the game was the opposite of the 'controlled, comfortable, clean-sheet' win I forecast: Egypt (the 8.4% away-win side) led 2-0 into the 80th minute -- a genuine near-upset -- before Argentina's class finally told in a frantic 3-goal, 10-minute finish to win 3-2. Two of my reads broke hard: (1) BTTS -- I leaned BTTS-No (54.7%) with Argentina clean sheet 50.7%; Egypt scored TWICE. My Egypt lambda (0.68) was deliberately NOT zeroed (Argentina-Cape Verde lesson), which was directionally right, but 2 goals is a big tail off 0.68 and the clean-sheet read was outright wrong. (2) TOTAL/shape -- a 3-2 five-goal thriller, not a 2-0 grind. What the pre-match note DID anticipate: I explicitly kept the draw/ET tail honest and warned 'Cape Verde already took Argentina to ET once' -- Egypt did the same and more (2-0 up). Argentina keeps winning (class + late quality) but living dangerously; they do NOT close games out cleanly against a disciplined block.
_postmatch.lesson: TEAM-SPECIFIC calibration note on ARGENTINA: they are a reliable ADVANCEMENT bet (86% -> through, as with the 90% vs Cape Verde) but a BAD clean-sheet / controlled-win bet against an organized underdog. TWICE now a supposedly-inferior block has scored TWO on them and pushed them to the wire (Cape Verde 3-2 aet from 2-0 down; Egypt 2-0 up until the 80th). Stop pricing Argentina's clean sheet high and stop assuming a 'controlled 2-0' texture -- they concede and win chaotically. Weight their games toward HIGHER totals / BTTS-Yes / a live comeback-either-way narrative, even as the advancement stays ~85%. And the comeback pattern recurs across quality sides (Belgium 2-0 down -> won; England HT deficit -> won; now Argentina 2-0 down -> won): a top side is NOT out at 2-0 down with 15-20 min left. The advancement number was right; the texture correction is to Argentina specifically -- goals up, clean sheet down.
